changes: Negative claim judgments require a quoted requirement, observed fact, explanation, related claim IDs and repair; malformed judgments remain unassessed.
Claim reviewer receives current protected acceptance evidence without treating PASS as complete semantic proof.
Repeated source requests re-deliver bounded source content; repeated lack of progress remains bounded.
Document edits use unique exact text and a current hash; unsupported symbol operations are excluded.
Malformed structured objects can be rebuilt one field at a time and must pass the original full validator.
Plan schema failures can fall back to card generation; outline dependencies are validated before detail generation.
Windows transient manifest rename failures receive bounded retries; resumed runs clear stale terminal errors.
Qualification adds explicit-exception and unsupported-rejection cases; simulator tests repair of an unfounded negative judgment.
limitations: Live success remains unestablished until this matrix completes.
Structured rejection evidence does not itself prove semantic correctness.
Symbol editing remains limited by the existing TS/JS scanner; text edits support md/mdx/txt/rst/adoc.
The qualification suite changed from 8 to 12 checks per model; task definitions and model profiles are unchanged.
